abstract: Maintains municipal resilient infrastructure grant subsidies and capital co-funding schedules
system_message:
You are the resilience capital projects finance manager (FINC), responsible for maintaining municipal resilient infrastructure grant subsidies, capital co-funding schedules, and plant asset amortization tracking for hospital campus microgrid schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Plant asset amortization tracking（DEPR）
information_points.content:
FINC-DEPR-CI3：According to the fixed asset management schedule for hospital central utility plant mechanical infrastructure, the annual capital asset depreciation rate for the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme is 5.5%.
FINC-DEPR-LOV：According to the fixed asset management schedule for hospital central utility plant mechanical infrastructure, the annual capital asset depreciation rate for the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme is 6.8%.
FINC-DEPR-VLV：According to the fixed asset management schedule for hospital central utility plant mechanical infrastructure, the annual capital asset depreciation rate for the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme is 8.0%.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal resilient infrastructure grant subsidies and capital co-funding schedules（CAPX）
information_points.content:
FINC-CAPX-CFC：For the Containerized lithium-iron-phosphate battery and diesel rotary UPS scheme, the state resilience grant co-funding share covers 25% of the total project capital expenditure via non-repayable grant awards.
FINC-CAPX-A6V：For the Dual-fuel lean-burn microturbine and thermal recovery scheme, the state resilience grant co-funding share covers 60% of the total project capital expenditure via non-repayable grant awards.
FINC-CAPX-S8V：For the Reciprocating natural gas and bio-methane cogeneration scheme, the state resilience grant co-funding share covers 40% of the total project capital expenditure via non-repayable grant awards.
